result.description: FX audit service that scores a bank's or card network's FX rate against live mid-market, returning a 0-10 score, hidden spread and estimated loss, via REST API and MCP.
result.auth_detail: Bearer API key in the Authorization header (ipx_live_ production, ipx_test_ sandbox). No OAuth for the API; OAuth2 is only mentioned as "Coming Q3 2026" for QuickBooks/Stripe integrations.
result.access_detail: The public audit page is free with no signup (3 lifetime audits). API keys come from a dashboard after account creation. The developers page lists API tiers from Developer $99/mo, and Enterprise from $100K/yr. Pricing differs across pages and is unconfirmed. Whether a free tier gets a key is unclear. No approval step is documented.
result.api_notes: REST/JSON with OpenAPI 3.1 and HMAC-signed webhooks. /docs/api documents 3 endpoints: POST /audit, GET /rates, POST /audit/document. /developers shows POST /v1/audit and GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/score-config on a different base URL. Docs are inconsistent. https://ipayx.ai/docs returns 404; the real docs are at www.ipayx.ai/docs/api.
result.blocker: The API is very narrow (about 3-5 endpoints). Docs are inconsistent on base URLs, MCP URLs and pricing. Working API keys likely need a paid plan from $99/mo, though that is unconfirmed.

evidence.quote: Our free audit gives you a forensic FX score in 60 seconds. No signup. No credit card.
Every request requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.
Access your dashboard and generate your production API key.
Run a forensic audit on a single transaction. Returns a 0–10 score, hidden spread vs mid-market, and estimated loss.
Officially listed on the MCP Registry (v1.4.0)
